effects: Exactly `assets` USDC moves from the signer to the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets) in enter).
Vault shares (gUSDCq) are minted to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), computed from the vault's share price after accrueInterest, and has no minimum.
The vault forwards the deposited USDC to its liquidity adapter. This is internal to the vault and moves none of the signer's assets.
accrueInterest may mint fee shares to the fee recipients, which dilutes the share price used.
formats.shown: Deposit <assets> USDC for <onBehalf>, with the share ticker gUSDCq and the shares' recipient shown as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of gUSDCq shares minted is not shown, and the call sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` comes from storage (totalAssets, totalSupply, fees). The calldata has no share amount. Case 0 minted 13713e18 gUSDCq to the signer, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: gUSDCq'.
findings.fix: No calldata field can show it. Optionally add a note that the shares follow the vault's current share price.

cases.notes: USDC out (13713) is shown exactly. gUSDCq in: the asset and recipient are shown, but no amount, because the amount comes from the share price in storage. The reader correctly took the share amount as unknown.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `assets` USDC is sent from the vault to `receiver` (safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets) in exit).
Shares of `onBehalf` are burned. The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, and has no maximum.
If the caller is not `onBehalf`, the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` is reduced by the burned shares.
The vault may pull liquidity back from its adapter to fund the withdrawal. This is internal and moves none of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly <assets> USDC to <receiver>, with the share owner `onBehalf` shown as a field.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of gUSDCq shares burned from the owner is not shown, and the call sets no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)` in exit. Case 1 burned 19.772702013870962142 gUSDCq from the signer, while the screen shows only 'Withdraw exactly 20.1 USDC' and 'Owner'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. Optionally phrase the intent as 'Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}, burning shares of {onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: USDC in (20.1, to the signer) is shown exactly. gUSDCq out: the owner is shown, but the share amount comes from storage and the screen never names the asset. The reader guessed shares leave.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: `shares` gUSDCq are burned from `onBehalf` (deleteShares in exit).
If the caller is not `onBehalf`, the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` is reduced by `shares`.
USDC is sent from the vault to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), computed from the share price in storage, and has no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem <shares> gUSDCq to <receiver>, with the owner shown as a field. The token that arrives is never named.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says that USDC arrives at the receiver; only the shares redeemed are named.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. Descriptor redeem: interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}', and no field references $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker or underlyingToken. In case 2, 60271.999711 USDC arrived at the signer, and the reader was 'unsure... whether the underlying is USDC; inferred from the name only'.
findings.fix: Name the output, e.g. intent 'Redeem gUSDCq for USDC' and interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}', or add a constant field 'Receive: USDC' like the 'Share ticker' field in deposit.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount received comes from the share price, and the call sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. The amount is not in the calldata. Case 2 received 60271.999711 USDC, an amount the screen does not show.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the amount. Stating the asset (finding above) is the most the descriptor can do.

cases.notes: gUSDCq out is shown exactly with the right token (the vault, via @.to). USDC in: the recipient is shown, but neither the asset nor the amount is. The reader only guessed USDC.

redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver,.worst: redeem: the screen never says that USDC arrives at the receiver; only the shares redeemed are named.

summary.worst: redeem: the screen never says that USDC arrives at the receiver; only the shares redeemed are named.
